notes.title: Localization Update
notes.notes:
We have updated to game to support French and Spanish (LATAM) localization settings!
Massive thank you to the Locasaurus team and Translator's Tale Team for reaching out and translating our little game!

We also implemented some minor fixes, like a fix for the dreaded slime bug.
- a small bug that would occur when absorbing the slime element, caused the player to be stuck unable to absorb elements, THIS SHOULD BE FIXED NOW (Yipppeeeeeee!) (at least we hope so)

we also tried a few techniques to improve on performance, there's no telling if it actually worked (our PC are BEEFY), so let us know if you encounter any issues or bugs.

We hope you all enjoy playing this small QoL update for our little game.

(P.S. WE HAVE BIG PLANS FOR THE FUTURE OF THIS GAME, STAY TUNED)
